_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Government Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP) Alert/Safe-Alert Response
summary: The GIDEP Alert/Safe-Alert Response provides information on the applicability and impact of nonconforming supplies and services, including the effect of the failure on systems/equipment function, mission, or safety condition.
preparing_activity: GIDEP Operations Center, OS Naval Warfare Assessment Center, Corona, CA 91718-8000
use_relationship: The Response to the GIDEP alert/safe-alert provides information on the applicability and impact of the nonconforming supplies and services regarding the effect of the failure on systems/equipment function, mission, or safety condition.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The GIDEP Response format shall be at the contractors' discretion.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Response to a failure experience report shall contain the following information, complete to the extent by usage of the part, component, material, process or equipment, or to the extent dictated by the safety condition.

children.title: For nonconforming parts or service, the response shall identify the contract number, specific lots, manufacturing dates, and locations.
The effect of the failure on systems/equipment function, mission, or process.
Identification of date, destination, serial number(s), etc., of any units shipped containing the identified supplies part or service.
Identification of any inspection or failure records of the identified supplies or services and whether they were encountered in the use of these supplies or services.
Reports of any analyses that may have been accomplished on these supplies or services.
Recommendations as to corrective action or disposition of the identified supplies or services.
Identification of the contractor/manufacturer's contact point and organization.
DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
